title: FlowerRealmsAutoPrestige
description: AutoPrestige yea R for manual rebirth you need to be on fabric version 1.21.11 and fabric api is needed
body:
PrestigeMacro is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod for FlowerRealms that automates the prestige process and displays your stats in a clean HUD overlay.
Features

Auto-Prestige — Automatically runs /prestige and confirms the GUI the moment your level is high enough. Just enable it and forget about it.
Live HUD — Displays your current Prestige, Level, required level to prestige next, and auto-prestige status directly on screen.
Manual Prestige Keybind — Trigger a prestige instantly with a single keypress.
Toggleable — Turn the HUD and auto-prestige on or off at any time without restarting.

Keybinds
KeyActionRManually trigger prestigeF7Toggle HUD visibilityF8Toggle auto-prestige
How Auto-Prestige Works
Open the Prestige menu (/prestige) at least once after joining so the mod can read the required level cost. After that, auto-prestige runs fully hands-free — it detects when your level is sufficient, sends the command, and clicks the confirm button automatically.
Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Server: FlowerRealms (play.flowerrealms.com)
